payload.text: **Empty authority means THIS project.** A cross-project reference carries the slug, parses and round-trips, and every door that takes an address refuses it by name before resolving anything against this project, with a remedy that spells this project's own address; no door resolves another project's address. A reference that hard-codes the project name breaks on rename or fork, so the empty form is the one intra-project prose must use.
